name: Lonely runner conjecture
snippet: The lonely runner conjecture states that each runner is lonely at some time, no matter the choice of speeds .

name: [PDF] TIGHT INSTANCES OF THE LONELY RUNNER
snippet: It is shown that to verify the lonely runner conjecture, it suffices to do so under the assumption that the speeds are integers of size $n^{O(n^2)}$.
